archetypes.name: dyn-launcher-order
archetypes.rationale: Launcher epilogue ordering is the main regression risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed CI and implement launcher tails in python/agents.py. Verify each _finalize_launch hook list preserves the documented ordering for timing, usage, meta, stall, failure append, promotion, and stdout KVs. Pay special attention to TOKEN_RECORD ordering and failure-before-promote implement behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-sidecar-paths
archetypes.rationale: Centralized sidecar paths must not drift from existing IPC contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review LauncherPaths and every migrated call site. Check that each field matches the prior output.with_suffix expression, run_external_agent stale cleanup still covers caller-supplied stdout and stderr paths, and implement sidecar_log remains separate from output-rooted .sidecar paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
